text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Those were delicious. Phew… I ate quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wurst. My parents sent me a mixer along with the recipe, so I made them from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's German sausage, right? And you made it yourself? That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You don't usually eat this late at night, though. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The recipe yielded quite a lot of servings, so I have been eating them outside of normal meal times so they don't go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That makes sense! It's so like you to follow directions and recipes to a T! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or are you looking a little heftier than usual?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You're correct. My weight has increased incrementally from eating wurst every day.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And you're not worried about that?! You'll fall out of your weight range if you're not careful!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There is no issue. This weight gain is well within expected parameters.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: According to my plan, as long as I adjust my overall food intake correctly, my weight should return to normal in no time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, you even keep track of what your weight should be in your schedule? That's hard-core!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Since my parents went through the trouble of sending me the mixer, I wanted to make good use of it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: And in order to make the most flavorful wursts and enjoy every bite, I adjusted my schedule accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she planned, it doesn't take long for Eishin Flash's weight to return to normal.
